subject: Post-call: compliance checklist & evidence mapping for BlueSail integration
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evan Moore <evan.moore@bluesail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: compliance checklist & evidence mapping for BlueSail integration

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and have clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit-log retention window: legal requires 7 years for certain transaction metadata (we discussed wanting exportable, immutable logs).
- SOC 2 scope: you need confirmation that Redwood’s in-scope systems cover inference runtime and control plane separation for customer data.
- DPA negotiation target: internal procurement hopes to finish SOW/DPA review within 3 weeks.
- Pen test evidence: BlueSail needs recent pen test summary and timelines for coordinated tests.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Confirm what artifacts we can provide this week (SOC 2 report extract + control matrix, sample audit-log schema).
2) Provide a retention/archival options matrix (S3 export, long-term cold store, Redaction options).
3) Map a pen test cadence and propose a shared schedule for an upcoming coordination window.
4) Kick off legal/DPA review with your procurement > provide a DPA template and accept edits.

Deliverables and owners (tentative):
- SOC 2 summary & control mapping (Rachel) — attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2025Q4.pdf
- Audit log sample + export spec (Marissa) — attachment: audit-log-sample.jsonl
- DPA template + negotiation points (Ben) — attachment: dpa-template-redwood.docx
- HubSpot record with timeline (Rachel) — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8243

Requested timing:
- SOC 2 extract + audit-log sample: within 2 business days (EOD Mon).
- DPA template to procurement: by end of next week.
- Pen test coordination: propose windows next week or early Oct; we’ll share a proposed calendar.

Next concrete step: I’ll send the SOC 2 extract and the sample log file by EOD Monday. Ben will follow up with DPA. Marissa will scope how audit logs can be exported and the retention options.

If that sounds good, I’ll cc Procurement when we send the DPA template so Lina can triage changes.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025Q4.pdf (summary stub, 4 pages); audit-log-sample.jsonl (schema stub)
From: Evan Moore <evan.moore@bluesail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueSail Security <security@bluesail.com>, Lina Chen <lina.chen@bluesail.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance checklist & evidence mapping for BlueSail integration

Rachel —

Appreciate the concise recap, that matches what we heard internally. A couple of clarifying questions before your attachments arrive:

1) For audit logs, we need to confirm fields for: user_id (anonymized acceptable), request_id, model_version, input_hash, timestamp (UTC), region, and lifecycle events (create/read/delete). Can Marissa confirm those fields in the sample?

2) SOC 2: we primarily need the Trust Services Criteria mapping around Security and Confidentiality. Do you provide a control IDs list so we can map to our internal controls?

3) Pen test: our security team prefers an independent third-party report (summary) plus a timeline for Redwood’s remediation SLA for critical/high findings. Is that possible to provide?

Procurement note (Lina): we’ll start the DPA review once you send the template. Ideally we want to see standard indemnity and data residency clauses up front.

If you can get the SOC 2 extract and sample log by Monday, that would be perfect. Also looping in our security manager (security@bluesail.com) for visibility.

Thanks,
Evan Moore
Head of Platform Partnerships — BlueSail Financial
evan.moore@bluesail.com | +1 (312) 555-0144
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evan Moore <evan.moore@bluesail.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance checklist & evidence mapping for BlueSail integration

Evan —

Thanks for the questions — looping in Marissa for the audit-log specifics and to outline export options. Quick answers from our side: 

- Audit-log fields: we can provide the full list you requested. The sample attached (audit-log-sample.jsonl) includes those keys (user_id hashed, request_id, model_version, input_hash, timestamp_utc, region, lifecycle_event). If you need additional fields (session_id, token_count), Marissa can toggle on exports from the control plane.

- SOC 2: Rachel, attaching a control-mapping extract from our 2025Q4 assessment (redwood-soc2-summary-2025Q4.pdf). It includes control IDs and which services are in-scope. Evan, you’ll see sections for Security and Confidentiality; each control has mapping to the TSC criteria.

- Pen test: Redwood engages a third-party tester annually; we can provide a redacted summary for customer review and our standard remediation SLA (30 days for critical, 60 for high). For joint tests we’ll coordinate windows and a point of contact.

Practical next steps I recommend:
1) Rachel: share the SOC 2 extract and log sample (Rachel: please attach to HubSpot deal).
2) Marissa: propose two calendar windows for pen-test coordination (next week + first week of Oct).
3) Ben: share the editable DPA template to Lina and capture initial comments.

I’ve put the DPA template in the shared Drive and created a HubSpot task (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8243). Marissa — can you confirm if the audit export can be delivered as newline-delimited JSON or CSV?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0022

Attachments referenced: dpa-template-redwood.docx (editable), audit-log-sample.jsonl (schema)

Ben / Rachel —

This all looks good, thank you. Confirming we received the SOC 2 extract and log sample in Slack earlier today — Lina will start legal review on the DPA once she has the docx. A couple quick notes from procurement/security: 

- Audit log format: newline-delimited JSON is preferred; please include a short README that documents field definitions and retention semantics.
- SOC 2: redacted summary is fine as long as control IDs and test dates are present.
- Pen test: we accept the remediation SLA. Please propose two coordination windows (Marissa).

Procurement contact for contract routing: Lina Chen (lina.chen@bluesail.com). I’ll ask our security manager to provide an email for a direct intake if they need more artifacts.

Next actions we’ll take:
- Lina: confirm DPA comments (timeline ~5 business days).
- BlueSail Security: review SOC 2 extract and audit-log sample and provide any follow ups.

We’re aligned to move forward — thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Evan Moore
Head of Platform Partnerships — BlueSail Financial

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -0700
To: Evan Moore <evan.moore@bluesail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Subject: Audit export options and README (attached)

Evan —

On our call Ben asked whether we can support newline-delimited JSON or CSV. Short answer: yes. Attached is an example JSONL file and a short README describing field names and retention options. Highlights:
- Default retention window: 90 days hot; optional long-term archive to S3 (configurable to 7 years).
- Exports: can be automated daily or on-demand via API; includes immutable event id + checksum for tamper-detection.
- Redaction: PII can be redacted/pseudonymized at export time.

Proposed pen-test windows: Oct 4-6 or Oct 11-13. Please tell us which works for your team and we’ll reserve time with the vendor.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: audit-log-sample.jsonl, audit-export-readme.md
